exportDescription: Run this agent automatically on pull requests
targetDescription: Review PR diffs in GitHub Actions through the bundled runner.
runtimeDisclosure: Studio: {studio}. CI: {ci}. The CI model is an explicit override; quality and outputs can differ.
editPolicy: Edit the workflow title and comments here. Change execution settings in Configure. Agent prompt, Skills and memory are exported from the saved version.
bundleSummary: Bundled runner: {bytes} characters. This file contains reviewer-core and dependencies; download the ZIP to inspect the complete source.
requiredCheck: To block merges, make “DevDigest review” a required status check in GitHub branch protection. A failed job alone does not configure branch protection.
ollamaNotice: Ollama runs on loopback in a temporary hosted runner. The pinned binary is verified before execution. No local Codex credentials are exported.
openrouterNotice: Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY to GitHub Actions secrets yourself. The wizard never reads the secret value.
installNotice: Create an installation PR targeting {repo}, base {base}, from devdigest/ci, or download the files and commit them on a separate branch.
downloaded: ZIP downloaded. Installation becomes verified after a real Actions artifact is ingested.
runsDescription: Verified reviews executed in GitHub Actions. Stored history refreshes every 15 seconds.
refreshDescription: Enter the numeric run ID from the Actions job URL. The server authenticates to GitHub and verifies repository, PR revision, workflow and artifact identity before saving.
alreadyIngested: This run is already in history; no duplicate was created.
emptyBody: Export an agent, run the installed workflow, then import its verified result.
setup: Set up CI for an agent
gateNotice: Each installation records its own gate policy.
localContextDisclosure: Local filesystem attachments from agents and enabled Skills are not exported. CI does not receive this local Project Context.
